findings.note: "The owner's family could no longer keep up with the home." is a detail about a person (family circumstances) in a case study. SR-18 says never include any detail about a person, even when the fact is verified in the record. The sentence must be removed or reduced to the property's condition only, using a verified fact that describes the home and not the people.

required_actions: Remove or rewrite the first sentence so it states the property's condition without any detail about the owner or the owner's family (SR-18). Every other sentence matches a verified fact (f2, f3, f4); f5 (verified null) is correctly absent.

rules_broken.what: "The owner's family could no longer keep up with the home." is a detail about a person (the owner's family).
